title: Senior Security Engineer - Threat Detection
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers.
The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end - the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production.
You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company.
We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof-of-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering - including where it introduces risk rather than removing it.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.
You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara . We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

•
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Build, deploy, and continuously improve MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detections across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and application telemetry, with clear false-positive thresholds.

• Own the full detection lifecycle-from hypothesis, data validation, and baselining through deployment, tuning, validation, and retirement.

• Advance our detection-as-code platform through version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and improved pipeline reliability and observability.

• Identify emerging threat surfaces and build integrations that strengthen data ingestion, enrichment, and coverage across internal and third-party systems.

Waarom is Junior AI Consultant jouw nieuwe job?

title: Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager
description:
Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager
Role Summary
We are seeking an analytical and action-oriented Real Estate Transactions Manager to be the “engine room” of our infrastructure acquisition team. In this role, you will take identified sites and drive them from initial interest to a signed lease or purchase agreement. You’ll specialize in high-power EV charging sites, vehicle service centers, and parking facilities.
You will not just track deals; you will actively unblock them. You will serve as the central node connecting Legal, Finance, Technical and external broker teams, aggregating their inputs into clear, actionable Deal Summaries for our Investment Committee. Your goal is to maximize pipeline velocity while minimizing risk.
Key Responsibilities
1. Pipeline & Transaction Management

• Funnel Velocity: Manage a high volume of active real estate transactions simultaneously, ensuring sites meet our location, technical and cost requirements, track critical dates and hold stakeholders accountable to timelines.

• Negotiation Support: Outline key terms for Letters of Intent (LOIs). Partner with legal counsel to redline leases and related contracts, ensuring commercial terms align with company targets.

• Deal Closing: Manage the closing checklist, ensuring all contingencies (zoning, title, survey, environmental) are cleared prior to execution.

• Collaborate with local teams: Coordinate and streamline communication between Moove headquarters and the Japan team, driving efficient information sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and decision-making for real estate transactions.

2. Cross-Functional Due Diligence

•
The “Quarterback”: Act as the central point of contact during the diligence period. You are responsible for pulling in the right experts at the right time.

• Construction & Utilities: Coordinate with the project delivery teams of external partners to validate site buildability and power availability (MW capacity).

• Legal: Coordinate with internal and external counsel to advance zoning, land use, and permitting reviews.

• Finance: Collaborate to ensure deal economics fit within our CAPEX and OPEX models.

3. Investment Analysis & Reporting

• Deal Summaries: Synthesize complex data-financial models, site layouts, risk assessments, and legal constraints-into concise Investment Committee (IC) Memos that drive “Go/No-Go” decisions.

• Financial Modeling: Run pro formas and sensitivity analyses to test deal viability under different scenarios (e.g., changing utility rates, construction cost variances).

• Database Management: Maintain the “Single Source of Truth” in our real estate database (e.g., Google Sheets, Asana), ensuring all deal data is accurate and up to date.

Qualifications
Required

• Education: Bachelor’s degree

• Experience: 7+ years of experience, including a minimum of 3+ years of direct experience in commercial real estate transactions, development, or real estate private equity

• The “Closer” Mindset: Demonstrated experience managing transactions from LOI to execution. You understand the mechanics of a real estate deal.

• Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (financial modeling)

• Language Skills: Business-level proficiency in both Japanese and English (written and spoken)

Preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business, or a related field

• Experience with infrastructure or industrial assets (e.g., data centers, solar farms, logistics, or EV charging)

• Understanding of municipal zoning and land-use entitlements

• Familiarity with commercial or industrial real estate leases

• Familiarity with Japanese real estate market dynamics, local regulations, and public bidding processes

Success Attributes

• Structured Thinker: You can take a messy email thread involving a lawyer, an engineer, and a landlord, and turn it into a clear list of action items.

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason-the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. title: Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting & Consolidations - Full Time, Days
description:
Be a part of a world-class academic healthcare system at UChicago Medicine as a Staff Accountant. This position will be primarily a work-from-home opportunity, with the requirement to come onsite as needed.
The Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting & Consolidations, is responsible for supporting the accurate and timely preparation of accounting records and financial reporting activities for the University of Chicago Health System and its related entities and partnerships. The Staff Accountant supports the monthly close process through the preparation of routine journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial schedules related to investments, debt, insurance, eliminations, and joint venture activities.
The Staff Accountant assists with quarterly and annual financial reporting, audit support, and other Corporate Accounting activities. The role works closely with members of Corporate Accounting, Treasury, and other departments to obtain information, resolve routine accounting questions, and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
The position is expected to perform established accounting processes with increasing independence while escalating complex or non-routine accounting matters to senior team members. The role requires strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a collaborative environment.
Essential Job Functions

• Prepare routine monthly journal entries and supporting documentation for assigned accounting areas, which may include:

• Investment transactions, including income accruals, amortization, accretion, valuation adjustments, and gains/losses.

• Insurance prepaid and accrual activity.

• Entity eliminations and intercompany activity.

• Joint venture and partnership activity, including recording financial information provided by external partners.

• Bonds and debt service, including interest accruals, debt issuance cost amortization, and debt service payments.

• Grants and pledges, including recording, reconciling, and reporting related activity.

• Perform established accounting processes in accordance with GAAP and department procedures.

• Participate in the monthly close process by completing assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.

• Research and resolve accounting discrepancies, escalating complex or unusual items to senior team members.

• Prepare monthly account reconciliations for assigned investment, insurance, elimination, joint venture, debt, grants, pledges, and related accounts.

• Analyze account activity and investigate variances and reconciling items.

• Maintain accurate and organized supporting documentation for journal entries and reconciliations.

• Assist with roll-forward schedules and other supporting schedules used in financial reporting and audit activities.

• Follow up with internal departments and external parties as needed to obtain supporting information.

• Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting schedules.

• Support the preparation of bond and debt compliance reports by providing assigned financial information and supporting schedules.

• Assist with quarterly and annual financial statement close and reporting activities.

• Provide requested schedules, documentation, and account support for interim and year-end financial statement audits.

• Assist with maintaining audit schedules and responding to routine audit requests.

• Support the preparation of consolidated financial reporting by completing assigned accounting and reconciliation activities.

• Participate in special projects and operational improvement initiatives as requested by leadership.

• Assist with documenting accounting processes and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Support other members of the Corporate Accounting team with routine accounting and reporting activities as needed.

Conhecimento prático em ETL e desenvolvimento de integrações de dados .

Pratica no desenvolvimento de integrações utilizando Python .

Conhecimento com  AWS Lambda e desenvolvimento de aplicações serverless.

Pratica no desenho e desenvolvimento de APIs, adaptadores ou serviços de integração entre aplicações corporativas.

Conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e padrões de integração assíncrona.

Familiaridade com serviços de integração e mensageria da AWS, como Amazon S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Kinesis ou API Gateway .

Conhecimento na integração de plataformas de trading com sistemas corporativos, como plataformas de preços/dados de mercado, sistemas ERP e Data Warehouses.

description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Safety Management System Lead.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

Join our team to work on cutting-edge power conversion technologies, developing solutions that combine high power density, high voltage and current, fast dynamic response, and demanding efficiency and reliability requirements. You will work closely with colleagues across integrated electronics, embedded software, mechanical, thermal, and system engineering.

- Build prototypes and perform laboratory testing, characterization, verification, troubleshooting, and validation of power electronic circuits and converter stages.

- Analyse test results and correlate measurements with simulations and calculations to identify design improvements and validate converter performance.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.

- You are experienced in taking power-stage designs from initial concept and simulation through component selection, prototype implementation, laboratory measurement, debugging, and validation.

- You are an expert in power conversion topologies, power semiconductors, magnetic components, and passive components.

- Experience with electro-thermal simulation tools such as PLECS is a plus.

- Experience with SiC or GaN semiconductors, high-frequency magnetics is a plus.

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

Sardine makes risk and payment decisions for banks and fintechs. Our customers audit us closely, and application security is a large part of what they examine.

Money moves through this platform, so real adversaries study it. Your job is to find what they would find, especially authorization flaws and business logic abuse, and then make the whole class of bug go away.

Little here is pre-decided. You determine where the risk is and go after it.

title: SDK Engineer - Python
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a SDK Engineer - Python to join our SDK team and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Build and evolve our Python SDK across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

- Start new things. Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

- Work in the open. Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

- Own the typing experience. Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

- Keep us honest across environments. Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks - with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

- Work on realtime. Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

- Track the platform. When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

- Design in public. Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

- Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents, which are now a major consumer of it.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Know modern Python typing deeply. You use generics, protocols, overloads and TypedDict as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for Any.

- Have authored or maintained a published library with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

- Know the maintainer side of open source. Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

- Are fluent in asyncio and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

- Know Python packaging for libraries: pyproject.toml, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

- Test as a habit: unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

- Write well. Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

- Have real autonomy: you find the important work, s

title: Analytics Engineer, Finance and Modeling
description:
At In Tandem , we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands-OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator-we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling) , you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

•
Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.

•
Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.

•
Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.

•
Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.

• Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

• Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.

• Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.

• An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.

• AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.

• Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.

• Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

We are an American Fortune 500 company headquartered in Centennial, Colorado. The company specializes in distribution and value-added services relating to electronic components and computer products.

At Arrow ECS we are at the forefront of new internet security technology, providing businesses with technical expertise. As a company we sell, install and maintain customer’s software and hardware solutions such as firewalls, antivirus, web filtering, virtual infrastructures, network traffic load balancers to name a few. Our customers can range from small businesses through to some of the biggest companies in the world. We work with these customers to ensure that their IT infrastructure is, fast, reliable, secure and most importantly working well for their needs.

Our main goal is to provide technical support to our Global customers and partners. Our portfolio is varied and includes best of breed vendors such as CheckPoint, NetApp, Fortinet, Palo Alto, F5, Microsoft and more so there is lots to learn!

What You Will Be Doing at Arrow?

Your job will be to provide technical support via email/telephone/remote sessions to our global customers, using initiative to help customers as much as possible.

You will deliver our range of technical support services and investigate any issues that arise.

Where necessary you will need to replicate customer configurations as required to troubleshoot complex errors, in details:

• Provide 2nd & 3rd line technical support via email/telephone/live-chat to our global customers, using initiative to help customers as much as possible. A percentage of calls will be of a complex technical nature.

• Resolve escalated support incidents from our customers and partners.

• Replicate customer configurations as required to troubleshoot complex errors.

• Progress simultaneous high-profile/high-priority issues.

• Undertake to develop and maintain technical skills in selected products.

• Undertake training to achieve and maintain accreditation in selected products.

Who Are We Looking For?

The ideal candidate would be someone who is passionate about networking, security, Linux and all things technical. On that role you will have the opportunity to acquire lots of new skills, so it's important that you are keen to learn and embrace new technologies and commit to rapid skills development.

Therefore, what is essential for us:

• Understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching and related protocols, network environments and topologies.

• Display a thorough understanding of networking protocols.

• Understanding and experience of TCP/IP, routing, switching and related protocols.

• Administration, installation and troubleshooting of Windows or Linux based devices and networks.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both telephone and written.

• Excellent English language skills both written and verbal, proficiency in Spanish. French and German language as an asset.

What is in it For You?

We have trained our engineering team to be able to cope with interesting, complex and diverse technical issues from small companies though to large enterprise corporations.

We believe in supporting new engineers in their training with industry recognized qualifications, as they prepare to work directly with our customers and develop their practical skills and experience in a range of technologies. Engineers are developed in all aspects of the role from customer services skills and specific vendor certifications. We will tailor your development and we will ensure that we hone your technical, customer service and professional skills.

Arrow is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

• 9+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering

• Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one

• Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs

• Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range

• Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

• Travel to customers 20% of the time

title: Post-doctorant.e : "Elaboration et caractérisation de matériaux inorganiques à partir d’une mine urbaine" - CDD 18 mois
tags: Matériaux à haute performance et éco-matériaux
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !
Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.
Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.
🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affectées au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal, « en décortiquant » la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.
Grâce à des outils d’élaboration et de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nous déployons le concept de «Material by design» : concevoir au mieux les matériaux de demain répondant aux enjeux de transition.
Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept. L’incinération des déchets ménagers produit, en plus de l'énergie, des résidus contenant des métaux et des minéraux. Des entreprises récupèrent et recyclent les différents métaux. Cependant, des milliers de tonnes de poussières minérales sont générées et sont généralement envoyées en décharge faute de solution de valorisation.
Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 18 mois vise à étudier la valorisation des poussières d’incinération par deux voies d’élaboration : voie géopolymères et voie métallurgie des poudres. Les matériaux obtenus seront ensuite caractérisés au niveau microstructural mais aussi au niveau des propriétés d’usage (propriétés mécanique et thermique ainsi que la tenue à la lixiviation). Le post-doctorant.e contribuera durant la deuxième année de ce CDD à une étude d’impact relative au procédés développés.
· Vous faites preuve d'une grande autonomie dans la conduite de vos travaux expérimentaux tout en montrant une rigueur scientifique exemplaire
· Vous rendez compte des résultats à vos encadrants et à l’entreprise partenaire du projet
· Vous participez aux réunions de suivi de projet et à la rédaction des livrable

title: Equity Research AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from sell-side or buy-side equity research, covering any sector, who build initiating coverage models, earnings models and data packs in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Research Associate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in sell-side or buy-side equity research, covering a defined sector or universe of stocks (e.g. TMT, Healthcare, Financials, Energy, Consumer, Industrials)

- Deep hands-on Excel: earnings extraction and prediction, calendarisation, SOTP valuation, data packs and nested formulas

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

The Role

Above Group is looking for a Structural Designer to join our Structural Engineering team and help carry projects from concept through construction. Reporting to a Senior Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for the structural design of the projects you are assigned, producing CAD drawings and calculations and turning an engineer’s vision into clear, buildable documents. Your work will directly reflect the quality and vision of our company standards.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You will collaborate closely with engineers and project managers, visit active job sites to see how your designs come together, and support construction-phase work such as shop drawing reviews and RFIs. We rely on designers who work well both independently and as part of a team, communicate clearly, and are committed to excellence in everything they produce.

title: Board Test Engineer
description:
About the job

Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.

Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.

Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.

You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.

Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.

What we're looking for

• Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.

• Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.

• Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.

• Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.

title: Lead Data Scientist, AdTech
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.
By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment
